topic: Tenses – Various exercises: Actions and the tenses in English
title: Which Tense Fits the Action?

explanation.tr:
Eylemin türü zamanı belirler:
• Tekrarlanan eylem / alışkanlık → Simple Present (She jogs every morning.)
• Şu an devam eden eylem → Present Progressive (She is jogging now.)
• Geçmişte bitmiş tek eylem → Simple Past (She jogged yesterday.)
• Geçmişte belli anda devam eden eylem → Past Progressive (She was jogging at 7.)
• Geçmişten şimdiye uzanan / sonucu süren eylem → Present Perfect (She has jogged 5 km today.)
• Geçmişteki bir olaydan önce biten eylem → Past Perfect (She had jogged before breakfast.)
• Gelecek eylem → will / going to (She will jog tomorrow.)
explanation.tk:
Hereketiň görnüşi zamany kesgitleýär:
• Gaýtalanýan hereket / endik → Simple Present (She jogs every morning.)
• Häzir dowam edýän hereket → Present Progressive (She is jogging now.)
• Geçmişde gutaran ýeke hereket → Simple Past (She jogged yesterday.)
• Geçmişde belli pursatda dowam eden hereket → Past Progressive (She was jogging at 7.)
• Geçmişden häzire uzaýan / netijesi dowam edýän hereket → Present Perfect (She has jogged 5 km today.)
• Geçmişdäki wakadan öň gutaran hereket → Past Perfect (She had jogged before breakfast.)
• Geljekdäki hereket → will / going to (She will jog tomorrow.)
explanation.ru:
Тип действия определяет время:
• Повторяющееся действие / привычка → Simple Present (She jogs every morning.)
• Действие в процессе сейчас → Present Progressive (She is jogging now.)
• Однократное законченное действие в прошлом → Simple Past (She jogged yesterday.)
• Длительное действие в момент прошлого → Past Progressive (She was jogging at 7.)
• Действие из прошлого с результатом сейчас → Present Perfect (She has jogged 5 km today.)
• Действие до другого события в прошлом → Past Perfect (She had jogged before breakfast.)
• Будущее действие → will / going to (She will jog tomorrow.)

examples.en: She jogs every morning.
She is jogging in the park now.
She was jogging when it started to rain.
She has jogged 5 km today.
She had jogged before she had breakfast.
She is going to run a marathon next year.

topic: Tenses – Various exercises: A letter with mistakes in it
title: Correct the Letter: Tense Mistakes

explanation.tr:
Bu alıştırmada bir arkadaşa yazılmış mektuptaki zaman hatalarını bulacaksın. Mektuplarda sık yapılan hatalar:
• Geçmiş olaylar için Simple Present kullanmak: Last week I go (✗) → went (✓)
• Present Perfect + belli geçmiş zaman: I have arrived yesterday (✗) → I arrived (✓)
• will'i if/when sonrası kullanmak: When I will come (✗) → When I come (✓)
• 3. tekil -s'yi unutmak: My brother work (✗) → works (✓)
• did + V2: Did you received (✗) → Did you receive (✓)
explanation.tk:
Bu gönükmede dosta ýazylan hatdaky zaman ýalňyşlaryny taparsyň. Hatlarda köp goýberilýän ýalňyşlar:
• Geçmiş wakalar üçin Simple Present ulanmak: Last week I go (✗) → went (✓)
• Present Perfect + belli geçmiş wagt: I have arrived yesterday (✗) → I arrived (✓)
• will-i if/when-den soň ulanmak: When I will come (✗) → When I come (✓)
• 3-nji ýöňkemäniň -s-ini ýatdan çykarmak: My brother work (✗) → works (✓)
• did + V2: Did you received (✗) → Did you receive (✓)
explanation.ru:
В этом упражнении нужно найти ошибки во временах в письме другу. Частые ошибки в письмах:
• Simple Present для прошлых событий: Last week I go (✗) → went (✓)
• Present Perfect + конкретное время в прошлом: I have arrived yesterday (✗) → I arrived (✓)
• will после if/when: When I will come (✗) → When I come (✓)
• Пропущенное -s в 3-м лице: My brother work (✗) → works (✓)
• did + V2: Did you received (✗) → Did you receive (✓)

topic: Tenses – Various exercises: English tenses in affirmative sentences
title: Affirmative Sentences in All Tenses

explanation.tr:
Olumlu cümle yapıları (özne: she, fiil: work):
• Simple Present: She works.
• Present Progressive: She is working.
• Simple Past: She worked.
• Past Progressive: She was working.
• Present Perfect: She has worked.
• Past Perfect: She had worked.
• will-future: She will work.
• going to: She is going to work.
Düzensiz fiil örneği (go): goes / is going / went / was going / has gone / had gone / will go
explanation.tk:
Tassyklaýjy sözlem gurluşlary (eýe: she, işlik: work):
• Simple Present: She works.
• Present Progressive: She is working.
• Simple Past: She worked.
• Past Progressive: She was working.
• Present Perfect: She has worked.
• Past Perfect: She had worked.
• will-future: She will work.
• going to: She is going to work.
Nädogry işlik mysaly (go): goes / is going / went / was going / has gone / had gone / will go
explanation.ru:
Утвердительные формы (подлежащее: she, глагол: work):
• Simple Present: She works.
• Present Progressive: She is working.
• Simple Past: She worked.
• Past Progressive: She was working.
• Present Perfect: She has worked.
• Past Perfect: She had worked.
• will-future: She will work.
• going to: She is going to work.
Неправильный глагол (go): goes / is going / went / was going / has gone / had gone / will go

examples.en: He writes poems.
He is writing a poem now.
He wrote a poem yesterday.
He has written ten poems.
He had written the poem before the competition.
He will write a book one day.

topic: Tenses – Various exercises: Find the correct English tense from the given verb
title: Put the Verb in the Correct Tense

explanation.tr:
Parantez içindeki fiili doğru zamana koy. Adımlar:
1. Sinyal kelimeyi bul (yesterday → Simple Past, now → Present Progressive, since → Present Perfect…).
2. Anlamı düşün: alışkanlık mı, şu an mı, bitti mi, gelecek mi?
3. Özneye göre biçimi yaz (he → works, they → work; I → was, you → were).
4. Olumsuz/soru ise yardımcı fiili unutma (don't, didn't, haven't).
explanation.tk:
Ýaý içindäki işligi dogry zamana goý. Ädimler:
1. Alamat sözi tap (yesterday → Simple Past, now → Present Progressive, since → Present Perfect…).
2. Manysy barada pikir et: endikmi, häzirmi, gutardymy, geljekmi?
3. Eýä görä görnüşini ýaz (he → works, they → work; I → was, you → were).
4. Ýokluk/sorag bolsa, kömekçi işligi unutma (don't, didn't, haven't).
explanation.ru:
Поставь глагол в скобках в правильное время. Шаги:
1. Найди маркер (yesterday → Simple Past, now → Present Progressive, since → Present Perfect…).
2. Подумай о смысле: привычка, сейчас, закончено, будущее?
3. Напиши форму по подлежащему (he → works, they → work; I → was, you → were).
4. В отрицании/вопросе не забудь вспомогательный глагол (don't, didn't, haven't).

examples.en: She (go) to bed late yesterday. → She went to bed late yesterday.
Look! They (dance). → They are dancing.
I (know) him since 2015. → I have known him since 2015.
He (not / like) fish. → He doesn't like fish.
We (travel) to Baku next month. → We are travelling / are going to travel to Baku next month.
examples.ru: В следующем месяце мы едем в Баку.

examples.en: When I arrived, she (cook). → she was cooking.

topic: Tenses – Various exercises: Find the correct tense
title: Find the Correct Tense

explanation.tr:
Cümlelerde hangi zamanın kullanıldığını tanımak, doğru zamanı seçmenin ilk adımıdır:
• works / doesn't work → Simple Present
• is working → Present Progressive
• worked / didn't work → Simple Past
• was working → Past Progressive
• has worked → Present Perfect
• had worked → Past Perfect
• will work → will-future
• is going to work → going to-future
explanation.tk:
Sözlemlerde haýsy zamanyň ulanylandygyny tanamak dogry zamany saýlamagyň ilkinji ädimidir:
• works / doesn't work → Simple Present
• is working → Present Progressive
• worked / didn't work → Simple Past
• was working → Past Progressive
• has worked → Present Perfect
• had worked → Past Perfect
• will work → will-future
• is going to work → going to-future
explanation.ru:
Умение узнать время в предложении — первый шаг к правильному выбору:
• works / doesn't work → Simple Present
• is working → Present Progressive
• worked / didn't work → Simple Past
• was working → Past Progressive
• has worked → Present Perfect
• had worked → Past Perfect
• will work → will-future
• is going to work → going to-future

examples.en: They have finished. → Present Perfect
He was sleeping. → Past Progressive
I'll help you. → will-future
She had gone. → Past Perfect
We are going to win. → going to-future
It doesn't matter. → Simple Present

topic: Tenses – Various exercises: Find the tense – statements
title: Identify the Tense in Statements

explanation.tr:
Olumlu cümlede zamanı tanımak için fiil grubuna bak:
• Tek fiil + (s) → Simple Present (plays)
• Tek fiil + ed / 2. hâl → Simple Past (played, went)
• am/is/are + ing → Present Progressive
• was/were + ing → Past Progressive
• have/has + V3 → Present Perfect
• had + V3 → Past Perfect
• have/has been + ing → Present Perfect Progressive
• will + fiil → will-future; will be + ing → Future Progressive
explanation.tk:
Tassyklaýjy sözlemde zamany tanamak üçin işlik toparyna seret:
• Ýeke işlik + (s) → Simple Present (plays)
• Ýeke işlik + ed / 2-nji görnüş → Simple Past (played, went)
• am/is/are + ing → Present Progressive
• was/were + ing → Past Progressive
• have/has + V3 → Present Perfect
• had + V3 → Past Perfect
• have/has been + ing → Present Perfect Progressive
• will + işlik → will-future; will be + ing → Future Progressive
explanation.ru:
Чтобы узнать время в утверждении, смотри на группу глагола:
• Один глагол + (s) → Simple Present (plays)
• Один глагол + ed / 2-я форма → Simple Past (played, went)
• am/is/are + ing → Present Progressive
• was/were + ing → Past Progressive
• have/has + V3 → Present Perfect
• had + V3 → Past Perfect
• have/has been + ing → Present Perfect Progressive
• will + глагол → will-future; will be + ing → Future Progressive

examples.en: She plays the violin. → Simple Present
She has been playing for an hour. → Present Perfect Progressive
She played at the concert. → Simple Past
She will be playing at 8. → Future Progressive
She had played before. → Past Perfect
She is playing now. → Present Progressive
